crew.overview: In 2006, a group of thieves performed what is considered one of the most famous and smart bank heists in the history of Argentina. How they robbed the Rio bank is as surprising as what happened afterwards. This is their story.
crew.title: The Heist of the Century

details.biography:
Ariel Winograd was born in Buenos Aires on August 23, 1977. He graduated as a director from the Universidad del Cine.

Winograd's first works as a director were four short films, which, as a particularity, all of them were led by dwarf actors. Later he made a documentary titled Fanatics. His first feature film was Cheese Face, a film based on his own life.
details.name: Ariel Winograd
